product_overview: Jawak is a bid-based marketplace for custom apparel manufacturing where clients post design requests, vendors bid and produce orders, and admins oversee disputes and marketplace activity. The web app is role-based, with separate experiences for clients, vendors, and admins.
core_goals: Let clients post custom apparel requests and manage them through award and completion
Let vendors discover relevant jobs, submit bids, and manage assigned production work
Let both sides communicate through in-app messaging tied to requests
Let clients track orders, confirm delivery, and leave reviews
Let admins review and resolve disputes while monitoring marketplace analytics

features.name: Public Landing Page
features.description: A public marketing page introduces the marketplace and directs visitors to sign in.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View marketing content -> Follow a call to action to /login

features.name: Google OAuth Login
features.description: Users sign in with Google and are routed to the dashboard for their role.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Start Google sign-in -> Complete the Google OAuth popup -> See the role-specific dashboard

features.name: Role-based Routing Guard
features.description: Protected areas route users into the correct role namespace and redirect unauthenticated visitors to sign in.
user_flows: Navigate to a protected route -> Get redirected to /login when not signed in

features.name: Create Design Request
features.description: Clients create a multipart design request with apparel details, an uploaded design image, and optional reference images.
user_flows: Navigate to /client/requests/new -> Enter request details -> Upload a design image -> Add optional reference images -> Submit the request -> See the created request detail
Navigate to /client/requests/new -> Enter incomplete or invalid request details -> Submit the request -> See inline validation messages

features.name: Manage Own Requests
features.description: Clients browse their own requests, filter by status, open details, edit open requests, and delete requests they no longer need.
user_flows: Navigate to /client/requests -> Filter requests by status -> Open a request detail -> Review the request information
Navigate to /client/requests -> Open a request detail -> Choose to edit the request -> Update request details -> Save changes -> See the updated request
Navigate to /client/requests -> Open a request detail -> Choose to delete the request -> Confirm deletion -> Return to the requests list without that request

features.name: Compare and Award Bids
features.description: Clients compare vendor bids on a request and accept one to award the job and create an order.
user_flows: Navigate to /client/requests -> Open a request detail -> Review the bids and vendor information -> Accept one bid -> See the request move to an awarded state with an order created
Navigate to /client/requests -> Open a request detail -> Review the bids and vendor information -> Open a vendor profile from the bid context -> Review the vendor rating, reviews, and portfolio

features.name: Browse Vendors
features.description: Clients browse the vendor directory and inspect vendor profiles, ratings, reviews, and portfolio work.
user_flows: Navigate to /client/vendors -> Browse vendor cards -> Open a vendor profile -> Review the vendor's rating, reviews, and portfolio

features.name: Track Orders and Confirm Delivery
features.description: Clients follow order progress, confirm delivery when the work arrives, and leave a review after completion.
user_flows: Navigate to /client/orders -> Open an order detail -> Review the production timeline and current stage -> Confirm delivery -> See the order marked completed
Navigate to /client/orders -> Open an order detail -> Submit a review after completion -> See the review recorded on the order

features.name: Vendor Profile and Portfolio
features.description: Vendors create or edit their business profile and manage portfolio images.
user_flows: Navigate to /vendor/profile -> Enter company profile details -> Upload portfolio images -> Save the profile -> See the vendor profile created or updated
Navigate to /vendor/profile -> Open the portfolio manager -> Remove a portfolio item -> See the portfolio updated

features.name: Vendor Job Board and Bidding
features.description: Vendors browse open design requests, open a job, submit a bid, and manage their own bids.
user_flows: Navigate to /vendor/jobs -> Browse open job requests -> Open a job detail -> Enter bid price, delivery days, and message -> Submit the bid -> See the bid listed on the job
Navigate to /vendor/jobs -> Browse open job requests -> Open a job detail -> Review an existing bid indicator -> Leave without submitting a duplicate bid
Navigate to /vendor/bids -> Review own bids -> Withdraw a pending bid -> See the bid status update

features.name: Vendor Production Updates
features.description: Vendors post forward-moving production milestones on assigned orders, optionally attaching images.
user_flows: Navigate to /vendor/orders -> Open an assigned order -> Add a production update with stage and note -> Optionally upload an image -> Submit the update -> See the timeline advance
Navigate to /vendor/orders -> Open an assigned order -> Choose the next available stage only -> Submit the update -> See the order's production history updated

features.name: Messaging
features.description: Clients and vendors communicate in conversation threads tied to a design request.
user_flows: Navigate to /client/messages -> Open a conversation -> Type a message -> Send it -> See the new message in the thread
Navigate to /vendor/messages -> Open a conversation -> Type a message -> Send it -> See the new message in the thread

features.name: Admin Analytics
features.description: Admins view marketplace volume metrics, charts, and top vendors in an overview dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Review the analytics overview -> Inspect totals, charts, and top vendors

features.name: Admin Dispute Resolution
features.description: Admins review disputes, open dispute details, and resolve or reject them with a written note.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/disputes -> Filter disputes by status -> Open a dispute detail -> Review the complaint and context -> Resolve or reject the dispute with a resolution note -> See the dispute status updated

features.name: Notifications
features.description: All roles can view unread notifications and mark them as read from the shared notification bell.
user_flows: Navigate to a signed-in area such as /client -> View unread notification badge -> Open notifications -> Mark a notification as read -> See the unread count decrease

routes.description: Public marketing landing page with CTAs to /login
Google OAuth sign-in page (Google Identity Services only)
Client list of own design requests with status filters
Create a new design request (multipart, with design image)
Request detail incl. reference images and received bids
Vendor detail with rating, reviews, portfolio
Order detail with production timeline, confirm delivery, review
Open job board of client design requests
Vendor list of own bids, withdraw pending bids

features.name: Public Landing Page

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is Google OAuth only, with no email/password path. Automated tests cannot log in without valid Google credentials, so all auth-gated routes are effectively unreachable to an unauthenticated test runner.
known_limitations.impact: Only the public landing page and login page are testable end-to-end without a real Google session; every client/vendor/admin route redirects to /login.

known_limitations.issue: The frontend is a BFF that proxies to a separate Django REST API. Full functionality requires a live Django backend reachable at DJANGO_API_URL.
known_limitations.impact: Data-driven flows fail if the backend is not running or seeded.

known_limitations.issue: Role-based access is enforced optimistically in proxy.ts, not as a security boundary; real enforcement is server-side in Django.
known_limitations.impact: Route-guard tests validate redirects only, not authorization.
